prompt:

Original A (two portraits) has final authority for facial identity; original B (front/rear body and face) has final authority for body/costume. Any attached approved generated views are supplemental consistency guides; originals override them. Never use generated guides as sole identity evidence. Preserve original facial proportions: elongated slightly hooded green-hazel eyes, natural original eye size and spacing, substantial softly rounded nose tip/alar width, full but natural lips with fuller lower lip and slightly irregular Cupid's bow, soft cheek volumes and rounded substantial chin/lower face. No narrow nose, pointed chin, larger eyes, glamour retouch or makeup. Preserve the uneven source freckles (restrained forehead density), pores, warm-neutral real skin and subtle red/brown variation. Medium-brown untidy wavy/curly hair in loose high ponytail, lifted crown and asymmetric forehead/temple curls to jaw/neck. No sleek hair, bun, braid or alternative hairstyle. Keep body silhouette moderate and original, no slimming or exaggerated anatomy. Costume remains roomy cropped charcoal-gray coarse knit crew-neck sweater with THREE broad very dark navy/charcoal torso stripes and wider gray intervals, gray ribbed collar/cuffs/hem and roomy long sleeves; loose high-waist washed nearly black jeans, no belt; black tall lace-up rounded-toe thick-platform combat boots with subdued black hardware/seams and continuous black soles, absolutely NO yellow/tan welt stitching, branding or buckles; very fine silver necklace with original tiny irregular pointed pendant, no enlarged or newly symbolic charm. Exact hidden profile geometry and tiny pendant motif are not known from originals; make conservative internally consistent proposals, not decorative invented detail. All views: consistent soft neutral studio lighting, uniform light-gray seamless background, photoreal physically plausible anatomy/materials, orthographic or 100mm long-lens perspective, sharp clear surfaces without strong depth-of-field, no dramatic acting or poses, no beauty filters, stylization, inset, labels, collage, sheet or watermark. ONE view only.

REQUESTED VIEW: High-detail garment crop from neck/collar through the cropped sweater hem and both upper sleeves, showing the source THREE broad dark navy/charcoal horizontal torso stripes separated by wider charcoal-gray knit intervals, upper gray shoulder area, ribbed gray crew collar and ribbed gray hem/cuffs where visible. Preserve exact original stripe order/phase and garment roomy/drop-shoulder construction. Visible coarse knit stitches, matte soft fiber detail, cloth thickness, subdued realistic roughness, natural shallow folds and seams; not a smooth shirt with painted bands, cable-knit redesign or fuzzy fur. Keep original charcoal/gray/dark-navy subdued colors. Fine original necklace may appear without any new jewelry. No face required in this material crop.

SUPPLEMENTARY GUIDE SCOPE: Any attached 05_body_front is approved ONLY for whole-body geometry, neutral A-pose and silhouette. Its warm boot stitching and denim wash/microtexture are rejected and MUST NOT propagate. Original B governs denim and costume; attached approved boots guide (if present) supports neutral black seams only.
